name: Emberglow · Gremlet #46
description:
The last warm glow from a campfire, still wandering around after everyone went to bed.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Emberglow in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
